summary: Playboy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting annual meeting results and a routine equity plan amendment increasing the share reserve by 10 million. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation event occurred. The filing covers director elections, ratification of auditor, advisory say-on-pay, and an adjournment proposal — all standard governance matters. No deal terms, premium, or strategic change are present. This is an ordinary current report, not a special situation.
